description: This PHP class, PumpStream, implements a read-only stream that supplies data from a PHP callable source. It conforms to the PSR-7 StreamInterface, providing standard methods for reading data, retrieving size and metadata, and handling stream lifecycle. The class facilitates streaming data where the source dynamically generates data on demand.

classes.name: PumpStream
classes.description: Implements a PSR-7 compatible, pump-based, read-only stream using a PHP callable source.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PumpStream with a callable source and optional stream options such as metadata and size.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the entire stream content as a string, or an empty string if an error occurs.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream by detaching internal resources.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the source and resets the position pointer.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream, if known.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position in the stream.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the stream has been reached.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates if the stream supports seeking (returns false).

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the position to the beginning of the stream.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Attempts to seek to a specific position, but always throws an exception because seeking is not supported.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates if the stream is writable (returns false).

methods.name: write
methods.description: Throws exception as the stream is read-only.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Indicates if the stream can be read (returns true).

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer, pumping more data from the source if necessary.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Gets all remaining contents of the stream.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns stream metadata or a specific key if provided.

methods.name: pump
methods.description: Fetches data from the callable source and fills the internal buffer.
